purpose: Teach: 下巻/ストローク/ガイダンス/仕手/各論/持ち味/後発/自助

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社史の下巻まで構想されたぞ
lines.en: Your father planned all the way through to the second volume of the company history from the very beginning.
lines.style: Measured, almost ceremonial cadence. Gentle nostalgia in the voice. Sits with the weight of the memory, not rushing. Slight pause before speaking, as if opening a door to the past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは交渉のストロークを巧みに操られた
lines.en: Yes. He had a masterful touch with negotiation—knew exactly when to push and when to hold.
lines.style: Respectful agreement. Quiet firmness, not recitation. Speaks from understanding, not just listening. Grounded eye contact. A son affirming what he learned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新人ガイダンスで直接お話された
lines.en: Your father spoke directly to the new employees himself during orientation.
lines.style: Soft admiration colored with longing. Voice slightly quieter, as if seeing him in that moment. Unhurried. Ends with gentle trailing, remembering the detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは仕手筋を見抜く目をお持ちでした
lines.en: Yes. He had an eye for seeing through to what people were truly capable of.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Not flattering—stating fact with the weight of lived evidence. Steady tempo. Slight depth, like he's still learning from what he witnessed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、各論を社員に深く考えさせた
lines.en: Your father made his employees think deeply about the principles, not just the procedures.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet pride tinged with longing. Slow, intentional pacing. Lets the words sit. Trails off slightly, as if he can still hear his father's voice doing this work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは当社の持ち味を全国に伝えられた
lines.en: Yes. He was able to share what made our company special with the whole country.
lines.style: Calm conviction. Not boastful—factual respect. Measured delivery. Word choice deliberate. Slight warmth on 「持ち味」—the special flavour. Grounded, almost humble.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、後発の業界でも一位を取られたぞ
lines.en: Your father achieved top position in an industry where he arrived late.
lines.style: Clear wonder in the tone. Not loud—contained and dignified. Slight emphasis on the achievement, as if saying: look what vision and character can do. Ends with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の自助の精神を尊んだ
lines.en: Yes. He truly valued—and cultivated—the spirit of self-reliance in his staff.
lines.style: Closing with gravitas and gentleness. Slower pace, almost ceremonial. Voice settles deeper. Speaks with the authority of someone who inherited both the principle and the weight of it. Final word holds steady.
